versions.text: Criterion: Verify that cross-axis coupling in roll maneuvers is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.4.3 Cross-axis coupling in roll maneuvers. For rotorcraft, the air vehicle meets standards within ADS-33-PRF, 3.3.9 Interaxis coupling and 3.4.5 Interaxis coupling. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.

Standard: The air vehicle response due to cross-axis coupling in roll maneuvers is no worse than Level 2 and does not lead to exceedance of structural limits, roll autorotation, or departure from controlled flight. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle response due to cross-axis coupling in roll maneuvers as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Cross-Axis Coupling in Roll Maneuvers paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle response due to cross-axis coupling in roll maneuvers as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Cross-Axis Coupling in Roll Maneuvers paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle response due to cross-axis coupling in roll maneuvers as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Cross-Axis Coupling in Roll Maneuvers paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
